items: > Data Fortress acquired. Fixer's description rejected.
> Data Walls resolved. That's a budget, not a perimeter.
> Code Gate located. Confidence remains outside.
> NetMap loaded. The reassuring part ends here.
> CPU count revised upward. Fee has not followed.
> Memory Units allocated. None reserved for good judgment.
> Interface ready. Operator requesting a second opinion.
> Cyberdeck diagnostics: operational. Survival estimate: impolite.
> Long Distance Link established. Not nearly long enough.
> LDL route checked. Every hop suddenly feels personal.
> Netwatch traffic nearby. Excellent timing, as usual.
> Arasaka markings resolved. This was priced as payroll.
> Militech logo identified. Updating the definition of overkill.
> Data Fortress scale exceeds the fixer's vocabulary.
> Code Gate appearance: ordinary. Defense budget: obscene.
> Data Wall inspection complete. I miss ordinary walls.
> Public access terminates here. So might the contractor.
> Fortress perimeter mapped. Exit strategy promoted to main objective.
> Multiple CPUs detected. Apparently paranoia scales horizontally.
> Local grid quiet. Corporate quiet. Different animal.
> Cybermodem online. Regret now available in full resolution.
> Interface plugs seated. Last sensible moment recorded.
> Neural processor stable. Opinions considerably less stable.
> Deck speed checked twice. Fortress still looks faster.
> Eurobucks pending. Neural tissue already committed.
> Recon only. Repeating that for the part of me loading Hammer.
> Watchdog identified. I preferred the architectural features.
> Bloodhound identified. Time to reconsider the return address.
> Pit Bull identified. A disconnection is not a clean escape.
> SeeYa on the perimeter. So much for Invisibility.
> Hidden Virtue detected. The scenery has supervision.
> Speedtrap loaded. The empty space is getting inspected first.
> Stealth active. Fear remains distressingly audible.
> Invisibility active. Not a legal guarantee of invisibility.
> Replicator ready. Several million bad impressions available.
> Watchdog patrol timed. Hands have declined to stop shaking.
> Bloodhound movement observed. My apartment feels relevant.
> Perimeter scan complete. Nothing here looks underfunded.
> Detection estimate revised. The estimate would like a lawyer.
> No alarm heard. That is not the same as no alarm sent.
> Hammer loaded. Subtlety removed from the proposal.
> Jackhammer available. The quiet approach has an expiration date.
> Worm ready. Aardvark signatures would be deeply unwelcome.
> Aardvark signature found. Naturally.
> Code Cracker selected. Code Gate unimpressed by the name.
> Raffles ready. Operator attempting professional composure.
> Wizard's Book open. No chapter titled Easy Money.
> Decryption pending. Reconsidering several career choices.
> Code Gate untouched. Keeping one good decision on the record.
> Data Wall still standing. So is the invoice discrepancy.
> Intrusion suite checked. Escape route checked more carefully.
> Fortress entry deferred. Calling that tactical maturity.
> Killer II loaded. Roman numerals are not reassurance.
> Killer IV available. So is leaving.
> Killer VI ready. Confidence increased to cautiously miserable.
> Manticore on standby. Demon signatures getting a second look.
> Hydra loaded. This is becoming an expensive bestiary.
> Dragon available. Prefer not to discover why it is necessary.
> Shield active. The word invulnerable remains conspicuously absent.
> Force Shield ready. More shield is a persuasive argument.
> Armor loaded. A comforting name for an uncomfortable situation.
> Reflector selected. Hoping the welcome package qualifies.
> Flack ready. Visibility is about to become negotiable.
> ReRezz available. The software gets better recovery options than I do.
> Backup verified. Unfortunately, it contains programs, not a replacement me.
> Packer loaded. Can't compress the consequences.
> Spare MU accounted for. Spare nervous system unavailable.
> Anti-IC suite reviewed. This was supposed to be reconnaissance.
> Hellbolt signature detected. Liability language suddenly inadequate.
> Sword identified. Corporate hospitality has an edge.
> Brainwipe identified. I would like to retain this objection.
> Zombie identified. Survival needs a more precise definition.
> Liche identified. My personality is not accepting replacements.
> Firestarter identified. Deck warranty becoming a philosophical issue.
> Hellhound identified. No part of this is a good dog.
> Stun detected. Standing still seems like a poor strategy here.
> Knockout detected. Declining the complimentary unconsciousness.
> Glue detected. The exit deserves immediate attention.
> JackAttack detected. Logging off is now an actual concern.
> Black ICE confirmed. The contract says nothing about next of kin.
> Anti-personnel software identified. I am the personnel.
> Neural feedback monitor armed. Would prefer it remained bored.
> Flatline identified. I dislike software with that much clarity.
> Poison Flatline identified. Suddenly sentimental about deck memory.
> Krash available. Trying not to make the whole fortress my problem.
> DecKrash identified. Saving the map while I still have a deck.
> Virizz detected. Action economy developing a corporate sponsor.
> Murphy detected. The program name feels unnecessarily honest.
> Demon signature resolved. Checking what came packaged with it.
> Imp II observed. Small icon, substantial reservations.
> Afreet II observed. The welcome committee has layers.
> Succubus II observed. Not following the attractive icon.
> Balron II observed. My fixer owes me a better adjective than secure.
> Crystal Ball ready. Checking the room containing my actual body.
> Open Sesame ready. The meatspace door matters more right now.
> Phone Home ready. Considering taking the name literally.
> Instant Replay ready. Hoping this remains instructional material.
> Filelocker ready. First I have to acquire something worth locking.
> Databaser ready. Prefer not to become the interesting data.
> Ono-Sendai Cyberspace 7 online. Professional hardware, amateur optimism.
> Hosaka status nominal. Operator status omitted for diplomatic reasons.
> Dermatrodes checked. The meat still has to survive the trip.
> Simstim feed available. Someone else can have the scenic route.
> Matrix geometry resolved. Wealth has excellent rendering.
> ICE boundary visible. The expensive kind of silence.
> Black ice ahead. The lowercase version is not friendlier.
> Icebreaker ready. The name makes this sound recreational.
> Kuang Grade Mark Eleven on the wish list. Budget says keep wishing.
> ROM construct imagined as technical support. Would settle for an insult.
> Construct storage considered. Declining to become a file format.
> Turing Registry comes to mind. That is a bad sign for a burglary.
> Tessier-Ashpool-grade money. Exactly the wrong visual association.
> Chiba hardware checked. No warranty on judgment.
> Sprawl instincts reporting. They recommend the nearest exit.
> Cyberspace cowboy reassessing the horse.
> Meatspace pulse elevated. Matrix pretending not to notice.
> Flatline is a program name. Keeping it out of the medical report.
> Corporate ICE silhouetted against the matrix. Beautiful is not safe.
> Data Fortress still ahead. Retirement briefly looks affordable.
> Cyberdeck still connected. This is becoming a character flaw.
> Fixer called it a milk run. Apparently the milk belongs to Arasaka.
> Netwatch can have this one. Feeling unusually civic-minded.
> Target files remain hypothetical. The Hellhound does not.
> Code Gate waiting. I hate being expected.
> Data Walls have better funding than my entire nervous system.
> Fortress survey complete. Submitting an invoice for emotional damages.
> Jack out, renegotiate, live. An underrated sequence of operations.
> Run status: technically possible. That was never the useful question.
